output.reason: The release-note line alone is vague [ev-493f55a0e705], but the linked PR fills the gap. It says the project's e2e CI step had failed on every run since March 31st because of GitHub Actions' deprecation of check-run status modification, so the step was removed altogether [ev-4b67f9e77498]. The only changed file is .github/workflows/e2e.yml [ev-fad7ab0ec433]. So the subject is the upstream project's own e2e GitHub Actions workflow, and the change removes the status-check step there; the shipped product is not touched, so no customer environment is exposed and doing nothing has no consequence, even though the item is listed under the BREAKING CHANGES heading.
